blocks.text: Israel’s vote this Tuesday is the first general election for the country since the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023 — an assault which led to one of the deepest security crises in Israel’s history. As incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu fights to retain power, the question is not merely who will lead Israel’s next government, but also how that government will navigate the region-wide security crisis that was triggered by the attack and the Israeli reaction, which included launching a war against Iran.
